title: When the Weather Falls
author: Juniper Dravenmoor
blurb: Wren Brightwater, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
